review_policy: The Al-Said rank and the paper's vocalized sub-reading/POS determine which homographic sense belongs to a rank.
Do not expand an undiacritized front with every theoretically possible homograph when the paper supplies a narrower vocalized reading.
CALIMA, Kaikki, corpus signals, and academy dictionaries are validation/adjudication evidence, not permission to overwrite the ranked vocalized sense.
Priority/modern-corpus flags are review signals, not automatic errors.
Full-block manual inspection was performed in addition to heuristic priority review.
